situation.name: marriage_divorce_dynamics_fear_effect
situation.description: Social model for marriage and divorce relationships with fear effect and nonlinear incidence rate. The model describes population dynamics of single males, single females, and married individuals with logistic growth and fear factor affecting marriage rates.

article.name: Dynamics of a Social Model for Marriage and Divorce Relationship
article.author: Helal, M. M., et al.

data.name: marriage_divorce_simulation_data
data.place: Matlab simulations with parameters from Table 2

compartments.name: single_males
compartments.expression: dM/dt = r*M*(1 - M/K) - alpha1*M*F/(1 + n*G) + beta*G/2 - mu*M

compartments.name: single_females
compartments.expression: dF/dt = s*F*(1 - F/K) - alpha2*M*F/(1 + n*G) + beta*G/2 - mu*F

params.name: male_growth_rate
params.meaning: The growth rate of male population

params.name: female_growth_rate
params.meaning: The growth rate of female population

params.name: carrying_capacity
params.meaning: The carrying capacity of the population

params.name: fear_rate
params.meaning: The fear rate from marriage (fear factor)

params.name: male_marriage_rate
params.meaning: Marriage rate for males with alpha3 <= min(alpha1, alpha2)

params.name: female_marriage_rate
params.meaning: Marriage rate for females with alpha3 <= min(alpha1, alpha2)

params.name: general_marriage_rate
params.meaning: General marriage rate with alpha3 <= min(alpha1, alpha2)

params.name: decay_rate
